title: abscond — equivocate

translations.translation: 潜逃, 避债

sentences.sentence: He was ordered to appear the following day, but absconded.
sentences.translation: 他被传唤于第二天出庭，却逃跑了。

translations.translation: 憔悴, 凋萎, 衰退, 苦思
倾听

sentences.sentence: Give ye ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.
sentences.translation: 你们当侧耳听我的声音，留心听我的言语。

sentences.sentence: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
sentences.translation: 众弟子阿，你们当来听我的话。 我要将敬畏耶和华的道教训你们。

sentences.sentence: The household went to bed; and I' too anxious to lie down, opened my lattice and put my head out to hearken, though it rained: determined to admit them in spite of the prohibition, should they return.
sentences.translation: 全家都去睡了，我急得躺不住，便把我的窗子打开，伸出头去倾听着，虽然在下雨，我决定只要是他们回来，我就不顾禁令，让他们进来。

translations.translation: 求助, 诉诸, 采取(某种手段等), 常去

phrases.translation: 万不得已（作为最后手段）

sentences.sentence: His punishing work schedule had made him resort to drugs.
sentences.translation: 他那累人的工作日程已经使他不得不求助于毒品了。

translations.translation: 屈服, 屈从, 死

sentences.sentence: Don't succumb to the temptation to have just one cigarette.
sentences.translation: 不要屈服于只抽一支烟的诱惑。

translations.translation: 屈尊

sentences.sentence: Travis called after her, but she didn’t deign to answer.
sentences.translation: 特拉维斯在后面叫她，但她不肯屈尊应一声。

translations.translation: 趋向, 往往是

sentences.sentence: People tend to need less sleep as they get older.
sentences.translation: 随着年龄的增长，人需要的睡眠通常会减少。

translations.translation: 蜷缩, 蹲伏

sentences.sentence: He crouched in the shadows near the doorway.
sentences.translation: 他蹲在门道近旁的阴暗处。

sentences.sentence: Paula crouched down and held her hands out to the fire.
sentences.translation: 葆拉蹲下来，把手伸向火堆。

translations.translation: 劝诫, 忠告

sentences.sentence: I expostulate with her on the impropriety.
sentences.translation: 因行为不当我向她提出告诫。

translations.translation: 撒尿, 鬼混, 游荡
散发, 发出, 发源

sentences.sentence: Intelligence and cunning emanated from him.
sentences.translation: 聪明和机灵从他身上散发出来。

translations.translation: 晒太阳(享受温暖), 感到温暖, 愉快或舒适

sentences.sentence: All through the hot, still days of their holiday Amy basked in the sun.
sentences.translation: 在整个炎热、寂静的假期里埃米都在晒太阳。

translations.translation: 闪身, 急转, 逃走

sentences.sentence: He jinked left, then right, throwing the plane into sudden turns.
sentences.translation: 他突然向左，然后向右，使飞机猛地旋转起来。

translations.translation: 闪烁, 焕发

sentences.sentence: What kind of mood can let person mind coruscate?
sentences.translation: 什么样心情可以让人精神焕发?。

sentences.sentence: No. The university should be the place where we coruscate our passion and resuscitate our prime.
sentences.translation: 不，大学应该是我们焕发激情的地方，是我们青春复苏的地方。

sentences.sentence: Subject participating in classroom teaching is the meaning of quality education; the effective route to promote the development of students' subjectivity and can let classroom coruscate life vigor.
sentences.translation: 主体参与课堂教学是素质教育题中应有之义，是促进学生主体性发展的有效途径，能使课堂充分焕发出生命活力。

translations.translation: 慎重的打球, 妨碍, 阻碍
食言, 违例出牌

sentences.sentence: He reneged on a promise to leave his wife.
sentences.translation: 他背弃了诺言，离开了他的妻子。

translations.translation: 舒适地坐定, 偎依

sentences.sentence: Sarah lay there peacefully, the child nestling by her side.
sentences.translation: 萨拉安静地躺在那儿，孩子偎依在她身边。

sentences.sentence: He nestled his head against her shoulder.
sentences.translation: 他把头靠在她的肩膀上。

translations.translation: 顺从, 答应, 遵守

sentences.sentence: The newspaper was asked by federal agents for assistance and agreed to comply.
sentences.translation: 联邦探员要求这家报社给予协助，报社同意配合。

translations.translation: 说孩子气的话, 说半截话, 闲聊, 胡说, 唠叨

sentences.sentence: Lou prattled on about various trivialities till I wanted to scream.
sentences.translation: 卢就各种琐碎小事唠叨个没完，一直到我烦得都想尖叫了。

translations.translation: 说模棱两可的话, 支吾

sentences.sentence: He is equivocating a lot about what is going to happen if and when there are elections.
sentences.translation: 他含含糊糊地说着很多如果进行选举会发生的状况。

text:
英语词汇 · GRE · 第 334 单元

abscond
音标：英 /əb'skɒnd; æb-/  美 /əb'skɑnd/
v. 潜逃, 避债
例句：He was ordered to appear the following day, but absconded.
他被传唤于第二天出庭，却逃跑了。

languish
音标：英 /'læŋgwɪʃ/  美 /'læŋɡwɪʃ/
v. 憔悴, 凋萎, 衰退, 苦思

hearken
音标：英 /'hɑːk(ə)n/  美 /'hɑrkən/
v. 倾听
例句：Give ye ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.
你们当侧耳听我的声音，留心听我的言语。
例句：Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
众弟子阿，你们当来听我的话。 我要将敬畏耶和华的道教训你们。
例句：The household went to bed; and I' too anxious to lie down, opened my lattice and put my head out to hearken, though it rained: determined to admit them in spite of the prohibition, should they return.
全家都去睡了，我急得躺不住，便把我的窗子打开，伸出头去倾听着，虽然在下雨，我决定只要是他们回来，我就不顾禁令，让他们进来。

resort
音标：英 /rɪ'zɔːt/  美 /rɪ'zɔrt/
v. 求助, 诉诸, 采取(某种手段等), 常去
短语：last resort — 最后手段
短语：tourist resort — 观光胜地
短语：summer resort — 避暑地；避暑圣地
短语：holiday resort — 度假胜地
短语：resort hotel — 度假酒店；度假村
短语：ski resort — 滑雪胜地
短语：as a last resort — 万不得已（作为最后手段）
短语：beach resort — 海滩度假村
短语：lender of last resort — 最后贷款者
短语：seaside resort — 海滨疗养地
短语：scenic resort — 风景区；旅游胜地
短语：health resort — 休养地，疗养胜地
短语：in the last resort — 作为最后一着
短语：resort city — 游览城市
例句：His punishing work schedule had made him resort to drugs.
他那累人的工作日程已经使他不得不求助于毒品了。

succumb
音标：英 /sə'kʌm/  美 /sə'kʌm/
v. 屈服, 屈从, 死
例句：Don't succumb to the temptation to have just one cigarette.
不要屈服于只抽一支烟的诱惑。

deign
音标：英 /deɪn/  美 /den/
v. 屈尊
例句：Travis called after her, but she didn’t deign to answer.
特拉维斯在后面叫她，但她不肯屈尊应一声。

tend
音标：英 /tend/  美 /tɛnd/
v. 趋向, 往往是
短语：tend to be — 倾向于；趋向于
短语：tend towards — 走向；趋向；有助于；造成
短语：tend to do — 倾向于做某事
短语：tend on — 照料；招待
例句：People tend to need less sleep as they get older.
随着年龄的增长，人需要的睡眠通常会减少。

crouch
音标：英 /kraʊtʃ/  美 /kraʊtʃ/
v. 蜷缩, 蹲伏
例句：He crouched in the shadows near the doorway.
他蹲在门道近旁的阴暗处。
例句：Paula crouched down and held her hands out to the fire.
葆拉蹲下来，把手伸向火堆。

expostulate
音标：英 /ɪk'spɒstjʊleɪt; ek-/  美 /ɪk'spɑstʃulet/
v. 劝诫, 忠告
例句：I expostulate with her on the impropriety.
因行为不当我向她提出告诫。

piddle
音标：英 /'pɪd(ə)l/  美 /'pɪdl/
v. 撒尿, 鬼混, 游荡

emanate
音标：英 /'eməneɪt/  美 /ˈɛməˌneɪt/
v. 散发, 发出, 发源
短语：emanate from — v. 放射；发源于；出自
例句：Intelligence and cunning emanated from him.
聪明和机灵从他身上散发出来。

bask
音标：英 /bɑːsk/  美 /bæsk/
v. 晒太阳(享受温暖), 感到温暖, 愉快或舒适
例句：All through the hot, still days of their holiday Amy basked in the sun.
在整个炎热、寂静的假期里埃米都在晒太阳。

jink
音标：英 /dʒɪŋk/  美 /dʒɪŋk/
v. 闪身, 急转, 逃走
例句：He jinked left, then right, throwing the plane into sudden turns.
他突然向左，然后向右，使飞机猛地旋转起来。

coruscate
音标：英 /'kɒrəskeɪt/  美 /'kɔrəsket/
v. 闪烁, 焕发
例句：What kind of mood can let person mind coruscate?
什么样心情可以让人精神焕发?。
例句：No. The university should be the place where we coruscate our passion and resuscitate our prime.
不，大学应该是我们焕发激情的地方，是我们青春复苏的地方。
例句：Subject participating in classroom teaching is the meaning of quality education; the effective route to promote the development of students' subjectivity and can let classroom coruscate life vigor.
主体参与课堂教学是素质教育题中应有之义，是促进学生主体性发展的有效途径，能使课堂充分焕发出生命活力。

stonewall
音标：英 /'stəʊnwɔːl; stəʊn'wɔːl/  美 /'ston'wɔl/
v. 慎重的打球, 妨碍, 阻碍

renege
音标：英 /rɪ'neɪg; rɪ'niːg/  美 /rɪ'niɡ/
v. 食言, 违例出牌
例句：He reneged on a promise to leave his wife.
他背弃了诺言，离开了他的妻子。

nestle
音标：英 /'nes(ə)l/  美 /'nɛsl/
v. 舒适地坐定, 偎依
例句：Sarah lay there peacefully, the child nestling by her side.
萨拉安静地躺在那儿，孩子偎依在她身边。
例句：He nestled his head against her shoulder.
他把头靠在她的肩膀上。

comply
音标：英 /kəm'plaɪ/  美 /kəm'plaɪ/
v. 顺从, 答应, 遵守
短语：comply with — 照做，遵守
例句：The newspaper was asked by federal agents for assistance and agreed to comply.
联邦探员要求这家报社给予协助，报社同意配合。

prattle
音标：英 /'præt(ə)l/  美 /'prætl/
v. 说孩子气的话, 说半截话, 闲聊, 胡说, 唠叨
例句：Lou prattled on about various trivialities till I wanted to scream.
卢就各种琐碎小事唠叨个没完，一直到我烦得都想尖叫了。

equivocate
音标：英 /ɪ'kwɪvəkeɪt/
v. 说模棱两可的话, 支吾
例句：He is equivocating a lot about what is going to happen if and when there are elections.
他含含糊糊地说着很多如果进行选举会发生的状况。
